requirements.summary: Remove any Caffeine.ai branding, watermarks, or attribution text from all frontend pages and components
acceptanceCriteria: No visible Caffeine.ai text, logos, or branding appears anywhere in the application
Footer, header, and all page components are checked and cleaned of Caffeine.ai references
Application maintains its existing functionality after watermark removal

file_operations.description: Remove the footer section containing 'Caffeine.ai' text and the 'Made with ❤️ by Caffeine.ai' attribution from the Layout component while preserving the header navigation and main content structure
